dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains physical and biogeochemical observations collected in Resolute Passage, Nunavut, during the Arctic‑ICE project from 8 May to 18 June 2010. Measurements include snow depth, sea‑ice thickness, under‑ice PAR, Chlorophyll‑a, Particulate Organic Carbon (POC), and Particulate Organic Nitrogen (PON). 

🎯 Details of methods can be found in **[Mundy et al. 2014](https://doi.org/10.3354/meps10587)** and **[Galindo et al. 2014](https://doi.org/10.1002/2013JC009497)**.

ℹ️ Before using these data, please reach out to **CJ Mundy (cj.mundy@umanitoba.ca)** and **Michel Gosselin (michel_gosselin@uqar.ca).**
